papers.title: Breaking the Softmax Bottleneck: A High-Rank RNN Language Model
papers.source_facts: pp2-3: row-shift log-probability factorization constrains dot-softmax. p4: a nonlinear mixture can escape that rank limitation.
papers.transfer_limit: Our necessary column-centered attention constraint is not its universal-approximation sufficiency theorem, task-posterior model or empirical evidence.
papers.proof_and_experiment_scope: Only listed main pages read; no complete appendix proof/results/code audit. No new empirical or exhaustive novelty finding.

papers.title: Low-Rank Bottleneck in Multi-head Attention Models
papers.source_facts: p3: attention representability is constrained by head dimension; capacity and value-output identifiability are distinct questions.
papers.transfer_limit: Its sufficient theorem uses full-column-rank token features and a positive column-stochastic target. We do not import that guarantee into a frozen-feature40-row output head.
papers.proof_and_experiment_scope: Only listed main pages read; no complete appendix proof/results/code audit. No new empirical or exhaustive novelty finding.
